subjects.title: Maths
subjects.framework: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics

units.title: Numbers to 10,000
standards: UK Y4 number and place value
goals: Read, write, compare and order numbers to 10,000 with place value
Round to the nearest 10, 100 and 1,000
Read Roman numerals to 100

units.title: Add and subtract to 10,000
goals: Add and subtract in your head with number bonds and friendly numbers
Add and subtract 3- and 4-digit numbers in columns and check with the inverse

units.title: Equal groups and arrays
goals: Read 5 × 7 as 5 groups of 7 and build it as an array of blocks
Solve story problems with equal groups

units.title: Sharing and grouping
goals: Read 56 ÷ 8 as sharing and as grouping
Find the unknown number in 8 × ? = 48

units.title: Times tables to 12 × 12
goals: Recall multiplication and division facts to 12 × 12
Spot patterns in the times-table grid

units.title: Multiplying made easier
goals: Swap, group and split numbers to work out facts (commutative, associative and distributive properties)

units.title: Multiply and divide by one digit
goals: Multiply one-digit numbers by multiples of 10
Multiply and divide 2- and 3-digit numbers by a 1-digit number, with remainders

units.title: Two-step problems with bar models
goals: Draw a bar model for a story problem
Solve two-step problems with the four operations and check the answer makes sense

units.title: Fractions of a whole and of a set
goals: Name fractions of shapes and groups
Find a fraction of a number (1/4 of 12)

units.title: Fractions on a number line
goals: Place fractions on a number line from 0 to 1 and beyond
See whole numbers as fractions (4/4 = 1, 3/1 = 3)

units.title: Equal fractions and comparing
goals: Find equivalent fractions with a fraction wall
Compare fractions with the same top or bottom number
Add and subtract fractions with the same denominator

units.title: Money and change
goals: Add and subtract amounts of gold
Work out change and the total cost of a few things

units.title: Time and how long
goals: Tell the time to the minute on 12-hour and 24-hour clocks
Work out how long something takes and when it ends

units.title: Length, mass and volume
goals: Measure and convert km, m, cm, mm, kg, g, litres and millilitres
Estimate and solve measuring problems

units.title: Area with squares
goals: Find area by counting unit squares
Find the area of a rectangle by multiplying
Split an L-shape into rectangles

units.title: Perimeter
goals: Find the perimeter of shapes and a missing side
Show that shapes with the same perimeter can have different areas

units.title: Shapes, lines and right angles
standards: SG P3 angles, perpendicular and parallel lines
goals: Sort triangles and quadrilaterals by their sides and angles
Find right angles and parallel and perpendicular lines
Split shapes into equal parts

units.title: Bar graphs, pictograms and line plots
goals: Read and draw scaled bar graphs and pictograms
Make a line plot with halves and quarters

units.title: Living and non-living
standards: SG P3 diversity of living and non-living things
goals: Tell living from non-living things by what they do (grow, feed, breathe, reproduce, respond)
Sort living things into plants, animals, fungi and bacteria

units.title: Sorting with keys
standards: UK Y4 living things and their habitats
goals: Use a yes/no key to name a living thing
Make a simple key

units.title: Life cycles
goals: Describe the life cycles of a flowering plant, a butterfly, a frog and a bird
Compare how they are alike and different

units.title: Plants: parts and needs
goals: Name the parts of a flowering plant and what each does
Test what a plant needs to grow
See how water moves up a stem

units.title: Living in groups
goals: Explain how living in a group (herd, pack, hive) helps animals survive

units.title: Traits from parents
goals: Show that young look like their parents but vary
Tell inherited traits from ones shaped by the environment

units.title: Fossils and long ago
goals: Use fossils to tell what places and living things were like long ago

units.title: Surviving in a habitat
goals: Explain how different traits help some living things survive
Predict what happens when a habitat changes

units.title: Food, skeletons and muscles
goals: Name the kinds of food animals and people need
Explain what skeletons and muscles do

units.title: Materials and their properties
goals: Test materials for hardness, bendiness, waterproofness and see-through
Choose the right material for a job

units.title: Rocks and soils
goals: Compare rocks by how they look and how hard they are
Explain how soil is made

units.title: Pushes, pulls and friction
goals: Show balanced and unbalanced forces
Compare how things move on different surfaces

units.title: Magnets
goals: Sort magnetic and non-magnetic materials
Poles attract and repel
Make a magnet

units.title: Light and shadows
goals: Explain that we need light to see
Show how shadows form and change size
Stay safe from strong sunlight

units.title: Weather and climate
goals: Record and graph the weather
Tell weather from climate in different places

units.title: Weather hazards
goals: Compare designs that reduce harm from floods, storms and strong winds

units.title: Working like a scientist
goals: Ask a question and plan a fair test
Measure and record results in a table
Say what the results show

units.title: Design and test a solution
goals: Say what a problem needs and its limits
Build and test two solutions and pick the better one

units.title: Retell a story
goals: Ask and answer questions about a story using the text
Retell fables and folk tales and find their message

units.title: Characters and their feelings
goals: Describe a character's feelings, wishes and actions
Explain how their actions move the story along

units.title: Who is telling the story?
goals: Tell your own view from the narrator's or a character's

units.title: Poems and plays
goals: Name the parts of poems (verse, rhyme, line) and plays (scene, cast, stage directions)
Read a poem aloud with expression

units.title: Main idea and key details
goals: Find the main idea of a fact text
Pick the details that support it

units.title: Headings, captions and glossaries
goals: Use headings, captions, bold words, glossaries and indexes to find information fast

units.title: First, next, because
goals: Put events in time order
Find causes and effects in a text

units.title: Two texts, one topic
goals: Compare the most important points in two texts on the same topic
Compare two stories by the same writer

units.title: Prefixes, suffixes and syllables
goals: Read and spell words with un-, re-, dis-, -ful, -less and -ly
Break long words into syllables

units.title: Spelling patterns
goals: Spell words with common patterns and tricky words
Check spellings in a dictionary (alphabetical order)

units.title: Nouns and pronouns
goals: Form regular and irregular plurals (mice, children)
Use pronouns so sentences do not repeat

units.title: Verbs and tenses
goals: Use past, present and future
Use irregular past forms (ran, took)
Make the subject and verb agree

units.title: Describing words
goals: Use adjectives and adverbs
Compare with -er, -est, more and most

units.title: Joining sentences
goals: Join ideas with and, but, so, because, when and if
Write simple, compound and complex sentences

units.title: Speech marks and apostrophes
goals: Punctuate speech with inverted commas
Use apostrophes for who owns something
Use capitals in titles

units.title: What does it mean?
goals: Work out a word's meaning from context
Tell literal from non-literal phrases
Choose between shades of meaning (knew, believed, guessed)

units.title: Write a story
goals: Plan a story with a beginning, a problem and an ending
Add dialogue and feelings
Use time words (later, after that)

units.title: Write facts and opinions
goals: Write an opinion with reasons and an ending
Write a short fact text with headings

subjects.title: History
subjects.framework: England's National Curriculum (KS2-KS3) with California world history, Cambridge Humanities and C3

units.title: Timelines
goals: Put events in order on a timeline
Use decade, century, BC and AD (also written BCE and CE)

units.title: History detectives
goals: Tell primary from secondary sources
Ask questions about an object from the past

units.title: Then and now
standards: JP G3 social studies (changes in local life)
goals: Compare homes, school and toys today and 100 years ago

units.title: The story of a place
goals: Find out how a place changed over time from old maps and pictures

units.title: Stone Age hunter-gatherers
standards: UK KS2 Stone Age to Iron Age
goals: Explain how people lived by hunting and gathering
Describe their tools, fire and cave art

units.title: The first farmers
goals: Explain how farming changed life (villages, animals, crops)
Describe a New Stone Age village such as Skara Brae

units.title: Builders of stone circles
goals: Explain how people may have built Stonehenge
Tell what archaeologists know and what is still a mystery

units.title: The Bronze Age
goals: Explain how making metal changed tools and trade

units.title: The Iron Age and hill forts
standards: UK KS2 (Iron Age hill forts, farming, art)
goals: Describe life in an Iron Age village and a hill fort

units.title: Great inventions
goals: Put inventions from the wheel to the internet in order
Show how one invention leads to the next

subjects.title: Geography
subjects.framework: England's National Curriculum (KS2-KS3) with Cambridge Humanities and C3

units.title: Maps and symbols
goals: Read map symbols and a key
Draw a simple map of a place

units.title: Compass directions
standards: UK KS2 (eight points of a compass)
goals: Give and follow directions with four and eight compass points

units.title: Finding places on a grid
goals: Find places with four-figure grid references

units.title: Continents and oceans
goals: Name and find the 7 continents and 5 oceans

units.title: The globe and the Equator
goals: Find the Equator, the Poles and the hemispheres
Explain why places near the Equator are hot

units.title: Hills, rivers and coasts
goals: Name physical features: mountain, hill, valley, river, lake, coast, island

units.title: Villages, towns and cities
goals: Compare settlements by size and what they have
Explain why people settle near water and good land

units.title: Your local area
standards: JP G3 social studies (the local area)
goals: Map how land is used near a place (homes, shops, farms, parks)
Plan a simple survey

units.title: Hot and cold places
goals: Compare hot, cold and mild places
Read a simple weather map

units.title: Where our food comes from
goals: Trace foods back to farms around the world
Explain how seasons affect what grows

subjects.title: Citizenship
subjects.framework: England's citizenship, C3 civics and economics, Jump$tart, Japan's and Finland's ethics

units.title: Rules and fairness
goals: Explain why groups have rules
Make fair rules together

units.title: Telling the truth
goals: Explain why honesty builds trust
Know what to do after a mistake

units.title: Kindness and respect
goals: Show respect to people who are different from you
Choose kind words and actions

units.title: Friends and falling out
goals: Solve a disagreement fairly
Say sorry and make up

units.title: People who help us
goals: Name jobs that help a community
Explain how people depend on each other

units.title: Needs and wants
goals: Tell needs from wants
Explain choosing one thing means giving up another

units.title: How people earn money
goals: Explain that money is earned by working
Match jobs to the skills they need

units.title: Saving for later
goals: Make a savings plan for a goal
Say where money can be kept safe

units.title: Caring for nature
goals: Reduce, reuse, recycle
Explain why every living thing matters

units.title: Jobs and responsibilities
goals: Take on a job in a class or at home
Keep promises

units.title: Big questions: what is fair?
goals: Talk through a big question and listen to other views
Give a reason for your view

units.title: Algorithms are instructions

Follow and fix someone else's steps

units.title: Code a robot

Spot the pattern that repeats

units.title: Find the bug

units.title: Big jobs into small ones
goals: Split a task into smaller parts and solve each

units.title: Inside a computer

Explain how hardware and software work together

units.title: Collect and show data

units.title: What is the internet?
standards: UK KS2 (networks, the World Wide Web)
goals: Explain that the internet connects computers
Tell the web from the internet

units.title: Keep it private

Make a strong password

units.title: Being kind online

Know what to do and whom to tell if something online upsets you

units.title: Screens and balance

units.title: Lines and shapes
goals: Draw with different kinds of lines and shapes

units.title: Mixing colours
goals: Mix secondary colours from primaries
Make tints and shades

units.title: Drawing what you see
goals: Draw from looking closely
Keep a sketchbook of ideas

units.title: Patterns and prints

Print it with a stamp

units.title: Texture and collage
goals: Show texture with rubbings, marks and collage

units.title: Sculpture in 3D
goals: Build a sculpture that looks good from every side

units.title: Art long ago
goals: Look at cave paintings and Stone Age art

units.title: Your gallery
